beats.text: Ivory Coast devotes 26.7% of its land to permanent crops. The global median is 1.6%.
This counts land for crops that do not need replanting after each harvest, such as cocoa, coffee, and rubber.
Ivory Coast has 13 times what China has, where these crops cover 2.1%.
India has 4.8%, Japan 0.7%, the United States 0.3%, and Canada just 0.02%.
Mongolia is the world's lowest, with only 0.003%.
How much of your country is planted with permanent crops?
